preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(G[0]) for row in G)
preconditions.description: All rows in G have the same length (number of jobs).

preconditions.expression: all(all(x in {0, 1} for x in row) for row in G)
preconditions.description: Each entry in G is either 0 or 1.
G is a non-empty matrix with at least one applicant and one job.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(sum(G[i][j] for j in range(len(G[0])) if j not in assigned_jobs) for i in range(len(G)) for assigned_jobs in combinations(range(len(G[0])), i))
postconditions.description: The returned value is the maximum number of applicants that can be assigned to distinct jobs they are interested in.
